svg.text: GOVPH • REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES • DEPARTMENT OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY
LIPA CITY DISASTER RISK REDUCTION AND MANAGEMENT OFFICE (LCDRRMO)
Protection Against Sulfur Dioxide (SO2) Gas & Fine Volcanic Tephra Particles

g.text: 1. RESPIRATORY MASK PROTECTION
• Wear an N95 or KN95 respirator mask fitting tightly across nose and mouth.
• Ordinary surgical masks or single-ply cloth masks do not filter fine SO2 gas.
• If N95 is unavailable, use a clean damp towel or cloth over nose and mouth.
Replace masks immediately when damp, soiled, or breathing resistance increases.
2. SEAL INDOORS & VENTILATION
• Close all windows, external doors, and exhaust vents securely.
• Place damp towels or cloth strips beneath door crevices to block sulfur fumes.
• Switch air conditioners to “Recirculate” mode to prevent drawing outdoor air.
Avoid outdoor recreational, construction, or non-essential athletic activities.
3. EYE & SKIN HYGIENE
• Wear wrap-around protective glasses or goggles when stepping outdoors.
• DO NOT WEAR CONTACT LENSES as ash abrasions can cause corneal ulceration.
• Rinse eyes with sterile saline solution or clean boiled cooled water if irritated.
Wear long sleeves and pants to protect skin against acidic volcanic ash.
4. VULNERABLE CITIZENS & ROOFS
• Elderly, infants, pregnant mothers, and asthmatic patients must isolate indoors.
• Ensure maintenance bronchodilators/inhalers are stocked for at least 7 days.
• Dampen heavy ash slightly before sweeping roofs to prevent dust cloud dispersion.
Wash all backyard fruits and garden vegetables thoroughly before eating.
MABILISANG PAALALA PARA SA MGA LIPEÑO (TAGALOG / FILIPINO):
• Magsuot ng N95 Mask: Ang sulfur dioxide (SO2) ay nagdudulot ng paninikip ng dibdib, pag-ubo, at pangangati ng lalamunan.
• Isara ang Bahay: Isara ang bintana at lagyan ng basang basahan ang ilalim ng pinto upang hindi pumasok ang mabahong amoy ng asupre.
• Uminom ng Tubig: Panatilihing hydrated ang katawan upang maibsan ang iritasyon sa baga at lalamunan.
• Tumawag sa Rescue: Kung mayroong nahihirapang huminga, dalhin agad sa pinakamalapit na ospital o tumawag sa Lipa Rescue.
